sentences.en: The body was identifiable thanks to a freckle on the left arm.
sentences.zh: 多亏左臂上的雀斑，这具尸体是可以辨认的。

sentences.en: Antifascists often mask their faces to make themselves less identifiable to the police.
sentences.zh: 反法西斯者常常会蒙上面具以减少被警方识别的可能性。

sentences.en: Tom's activism didn't seem to have any identifiable effect.
sentences.zh: 汤姆的活动似乎并没有产生任何可证明是同一的效果。

senses.zh: 可辨认的；可认明的；可证明是同一的
